scheme_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-II
description:
The E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu.

This scheme was introduced on 15th September 2008.

It aims to provide financial assistance to the daughters of poor widows to help them get married.

The primary objective of this scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on widowed mothers regarding their daughters' marriages.

The government has set a measurable target to assist at least 10,000 beneficiaries annually under this scheme.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is ₹50,000 per eligible daughter.

This amount is intended to cover various marriage-related expenses such as wedding attire, jewelry, and other necessities.

The assistance is directly credited to the bank account of the beneficiary.

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a widow.

The applicant must have a daughter who is of marriageable age, which is defined as 18 years and above.

The annual income of the widow must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.

The applicant must also be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

The application process involves several steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the local Social Welfare Department office or download it from the official Tamil Nadu government website.

The completed application form must be submitted along with required documents.

Required documents include the widow's identity proof, income certificate, and the daughter's age proof.

The applicant must also provide a marriage invitation card or a letter from the local panchayat confirming the marriage.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the local authorities.

The review process typically takes about 30 days.

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed within 15 days.

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme, Government of Tamil Nadu.

The contact details for the department can be found on the official Tamil Nadu government website.

This scheme is part of a broader initiative to empower women and support families in distress.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

Since its inception, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across Tamil Nadu.

The scheme also aims to promote the social status of widows and their daughters.

The assistance under this scheme is not a loan and does not require repayment.

The scheme is reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further.

The government has also launched awareness campaigns to ensure that eligible beneficiaries are informed about the scheme.

These campaigns include community meetings and distribution of pamphlets in rural areas.

The scheme has been well-received by the public, with many beneficiaries expressing gratitude for the financial support.

The government encourages applications from marginalized communities to ensure inclusivity.

The scheme is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly Goal 5, which focuses on gender equality.

The assistance provided under this scheme is intended to reduce child marriage rates among widows' daughters.

The government also monitors the implementation of the scheme through regular audits.

The scheme has a dedicated helpline for beneficiaries to address their queries and concerns.

The helpline number is available on the official website of the Department of Social Welfare.

The scheme is part of the Tamil Nadu government's commitment to women's empowerment.

The government aims to increase the financial assistance amount in future budgets based on inflation and rising costs.

The scheme has been instrumental in changing societal perceptions about widows and their daughters.

The government encourages local bodies to support the scheme by organizing marriage events.

These events help in creating a sense of community and support for widows.

The scheme also promotes the idea of dignified marriages for daughters of widows.

The financial assistance can be used flexibly by the beneficiaries according to their needs.

The government has set up a monitoring committee to oversee the implementation of the scheme.

This committee is responsible for ensuring that the funds are utilized effectively.

The scheme has received positive media coverage highlighting its impact on society.

The government plans to expand the scheme to include additional benefits in the future.

The scheme is an essential part of the Tamil Nadu government's social welfare policies.

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting vulnerable sections of society.

The government regularly updates the scheme's guidelines to adapt to changing societal needs.

The E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme is a vital resource for many families.

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that daughters of widows can have a dignified marriage.

The scheme has been a significant step towards empowering women in Tamil Nadu.

The government encourages all eligible widows to take advantage of this scheme.

The application process is designed to be straightforward and accessible.

This ensures that financial assistance reaches those who need it the most.

The impact of the scheme is evident in the increasing number of applications received each year.

The government remains committed to improving the lives of widows and their daughters through this initiative.
